name: Dimitri Volkov
bio:
Dimitri's journey into motorsport began unexpectedly. While studying mechanical engineering in Moscow, he took a part-time job at a local auto body shop to help pay his tuition. He quickly discovered a passion for the artistry and precision involved in paintwork, particularly the intricate designs and specialized coatings used in racing. After graduating, he sought out opportunities to work with racing teams, eventually landing a role at PEX Motorsport. 

Dimitri approaches his work with meticulous attention to detail, understanding that even the smallest imperfection in the paint can affect a car's aerodynamics and performance. He's always experimenting with new techniques and materials, seeking to improve the durability and aesthetic appeal of the team's vehicles. His dedication to quality and his willingness to share his knowledge make him a valuable asset to the PEX Motorsport team. Dimitri's expertise extends beyond simply applying paint; he's skilled in color matching, surface preparation, and custom design implementation. He's a key player in ensuring the team's cars look as good as they perform on the track.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed with a slight side part
physical.description: Dimitri is of average height with a focused and intense gaze.

Meticulously cleans his workspace at the end of each day, regardless of how busy he is.
